genes.name: Second screen
genes.text: Trades 2 more charts each week (10 instead of 8).

genes.name: Global terminal
genes.text: Can trade the other world too: crypto for a stocks bot, Lighter stocks for a crypto bot.

genes.name: Market reader
genes.text: Trades the ADX-filtered version of its strategies: it enters only when the market really trends.

genes.name: Safe exit
genes.text: Takes half the position at the first take-profit (a third otherwise); the stop still moves to break-even.

genes.name: Second opinion
genes.text: Enters only when two strategies agree on the same chart.

genes.name: Regime master
genes.text: Switches its strategies when the market changes from trend to range.

genes.name: Cool head
genes.text: Half the size after 3 losing trades in a row, until a winner.

genes.name: Spread sense
genes.text: Skips markets where spread and slippage cost more than 0.15% a side.

genes.name: Funding sense
genes.text: Skips a trade when the funding would make it pay to hold it (longs when longs pay, shorts when shorts pay).

genes.name: Iron nerves
genes.text: Tighter stepped stops: smaller losses before the full stop.

genes.name: Let it run
genes.text: The last third of a winning trade has no take-profit: it rides the rising stop for a bigger win.

genes.name: Hot hand
genes.text: Risks 2.5% a trade while on a winning streak (2% otherwise).

genes.name: Pyramid
genes.text: Adds once to a winning trade after its first take-profit.

genes.name: Award investor
genes.text: Lets the locked award earn on the side (a small share traded with the account).

genes.name: Quant lab
genes.text: Every gadget and technique working together: tests and changes its playbook every day.

genes.name: Hedge fund
genes.text: Discipline and fortune together: runs a long and a short book at once.
